text:
ameya: RFC follow-up: propose extracting a tiny 'runtime-sheen' adapter to own input canonicalization + backward-compat shims. small surface, safe cutover. thoughts?
jordan: What's the exact boundary vs request-router?
ameya: Sheen sits after router before runtimes. Owns canonicalizing timestamps/legacy fields, response shaping (truncate/map headers), and shims for older model variants. NOT routing, affinity, auth, or quotas.
lia: Keep auth upstream. If sheen calls auth over network that's a latency risk.
sam: How do we avoid adding an RPC hop cost?
ameya: Rollout plan: in-process module behind feature flag first, then network service later. In-proc avoids immediate perf tax.
jordan: Consider single binary + pluggable interface as an interim to keep deploy surface small.
lia: We did similar with encrypter; in-proc + feature flag worked well.
sam: Ops: add mem/caching guardrails and eviction metrics for sheen caches.
devon: Cutover checkpoints: regression prompt smoke tests, latency baseline vs canary, rollback thresholds (p95 +0.8s or error rate +2%). I'll own dashboard/alerts.
ameya: Rollout steps: spike -> inproc flag -> single-region canary -> broader canary -> global. Sample smoke: SERVICE_RUNTIME_FLAGS=--sheen=inproc; run curl test.
jordan: Need a compatibility matrix (old->canonical fields) in sheen repo + unit tests.
lia: Add tenant opt-in allowlist for shims; enterprises may opt out.
sam: Observability: tag traces/spans when sheen mutates payloads.
devon: Will add span 'sheen.transform' and metric sheen.transform.count with labels {tenant,transform_type}.
ameya: Policy: sheen may annotate but must not enforce auth/quotas. Router + policy plane stay authoritative.
jordan: Tests: small e2e harness runs regression prompts with and without sheen to assert equivalence within tolerances.
ameya: I'll draft the RFC follow-up, compatibility matrix, and checklist tonight. @devon can you create dashboard and rollback alerts?
devon: On it; will post link here.
deploy-bot: Provisional canary window scheduled 2023-10-04 22:00 UTC (sheen=inproc). Owners must ack 24h before.
lia: Ack.
jordan: Ack.
sam: Ack.
ameya: Thanks team; I'll drop the follow-up RFC + repo links by EOD.
